info.title: notion (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Notion REST API. Authorization: Bearer {integration_token}. Notion-Version: 2025-09-03 header required. parent_id can be a page ID or database ID. Page IDs are UUIDs (with or without dashes).

post.summary: Create a new Notion page under a given parent (page or database) with specified properties. Use the children array to su
post.description: Create a new Notion page under a given parent (page or database) with specified properties. Use the children array to supply block content. For public integrations only, omit the parent to create a private workspace-level page.

200.description: {id, object: 'page', url, public_url, created_time, last_edited_time, archived, in_trash, is_locked, parent, properties: {title: {title: [{text: {content}}]}}, icon, cover, created_by, last_edited_by}

requestBody.description: Body: {parent (required for internal integrations, object â€” {type: 'page_id', page_id: '...'} or {type: 'database_id', database_id: '...'} or {workspace: true} for public integrations), properties (required, object â€” {title: {title: [{text: {content: 'Page Title'}}]}} for page parents, or database property values for database parents), children (optional, array â€” block objects for page content, max 100; mutually exclusive with markdown), content (optional, array â€” block objects, max 100; mutually exclusive with markdown), markdown (optional, string â€” page content as Notion-flavored Markdown; mutually exclusive with content/children), icon (optional, object â€” {type: 'emoji', emoji: '...'} or {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), cover (optional, object â€” {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), template (optional, object â€” {type: 'none'|'default'|'template_id', template_id (string â€” required when type is template_id), timezone (string â€” IANA timezone for template variables)}), position (optional, object)}

patch.summary: Modify an existing Notion page's properties, icon, cover, archived or trash status, or locked state. A template can also
patch.description: Modify an existing Notion page's properties, icon, cover, archived or trash status, or locked state. A template can also be applied. Note: to add new content blocks, use the Append block children API rather than this endpoint.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the page to update.

200.description: {id, object: 'page', url, public_url, archived, in_trash, is_locked, last_edited_time, properties, icon, cover, created_by, last_edited_by}

requestBody.description: Body: {properties (optional, object â€” property values to update, e.g. {title: {title: [{text: {content: 'New Title'}}]}}), archived (optional, boolean â€” true to archive the page), in_trash (optional, boolean â€” true to move page to trash), icon (optional, object â€” {type: 'emoji', emoji: '...'} or {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), cover (optional, object â€” {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), is_locked (optional, boolean â€” lock or unlock the page from editing in the Notion app UI), template (optional, object â€” {type: 'default'|'template_id', template_id (string), timezone (string â€” IANA timezone)}), erase_content (optional, boolean â€” delete all existing block children before applying template)}

in_trash.description: Indicates whether the page has been moved to trash.

is_locked.description: When true, the page cannot be edited through the Notion app UI.

url.description: The public web address for this Notion page.

public_url.description: A publicly shareable URL when the page is published; null if not published.

properties.description: Collection of page properties. The 'title' key is always present; other keys correspond to property names.

created_by.description: User object identifying who originally created this page.

last_edited_by.description: User object identifying who last made changes to this page.
